name: Rootbound: Hug Trees
subtitle: Tree hugs, breathwork & XP
promotionalText: New: hugs link every breath session and Roamr walk, Nature Roll finds the nature in your camera roll, and trees in water earn bonus XP. Start a hug from your Watch.
description:
Rootbound turns time with trees into a calm little game. Step outside, find a tree, slow down and log the moment. Every hug earns XP, grows your grove and brings you back to the trees that ground you.

LOG A TREE HUG
Snap the tree, pin it on the map (live, from the photo, or from a pasted map link) and tag the moment from more than two dozen vibes, like sunrise, trail, birdsong or phone-free. Note your mood before and after, flip on barefoot, and mark a tree at the water's edge or standing in water for bonus XP.

BREATHWORK, LINKED FOR YOU
Breathed at the tree? Rootbound finds every Still Pointz and mindful session within an hour of your tree photo and links them all to the hug, with practice, minutes, heart rate, heart-rate drop, HRV and breathing rate from Apple Health. Tap Breathe with this tree to start a short Still Pointz session named after it, and earn a Breath & Bark bonus on days you do both.

APPLE WATCH
Start a hug from your wrist or the complication. Rootbound times it with live heart rate, taps your wrist at the start and the end, and your iPhone asks which tree it was.

WALKS FROM ROAMR
Record walks and hikes in Roamr and tap Sync Roamr: each walk shows up under the hugs it led to (Walk · 2.3 mi · 48 min · +410 ft), and every tree adds up the miles that brought you there. Walks other apps save to Apple Health count too.

NATURE ROLL
Rootbound looks through your camera roll on your iPhone and sorts out the nature: sunsets, trails, mountains, forests, water, sky and stars, wildlife and flowers. See what you shot on this day in past years, or turn a photo into a hug.

WHAT TREE IS THIS?
Rootbound suggests the species from your photo with on-device image recognition, then shares a fact about it.

XP, LEVELS AND RARE LEAVES
Climb from Seedling to Ancient One. Earn badges for streaks, seasons, sunrises, water trees, long sits and loyal friendships, and collect 12 leaves, from the Oak Leaf to the Golden Elder Leaf said to fall once a century.

YOUR GROVE
Every tree you've hugged lives in your grove, with friendship hearts, hug history, breath sessions, walks and a map of all your trees. Tap one for walking directions back.

SIRI, WIDGETS AND CONTROL CENTER
Ask Siri to log a tree hug, start one from Control Center, and keep your streak on your Home Screen.

FREE AND PRO
Logging hugs, the map, your grove, linked breathwork and walks, Nature Roll, XP and every badge and leaf are free. One optional purchase unlocks Rootbound Pro for good, with no subscription: tree selfies (a second photo on every hug), tree insights (mood lift, how your heart rate settles and your favorite time of day with each tree), CSV and GPX export, and the Nature Roll map and Photos albums.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics. Your hugs live on your iPhone and in your own private iCloud, so they follow you to a new phone and nobody else can read them. Nature Roll runs entirely on your iPhone; no photo is uploaded.

Rootbound is for fun and general wellbeing. Heart data is shown for your interest and is not medical advice.
reviewNotes:
No account or sign-in.

To try it: tap the big Hug button on Home, add a photo (or skip), and save; the celebration screen shows the XP. The Grove and Collection tabs fill up as hugs are logged. Walks are recorded in our separate Roamr app (or any app that saves walking workouts to Apple Health): "Sync Roamr" on Home attaches walks within two hours of a hug to it. Rootbound itself no longer records walks.

In-app purchase: Rootbound Pro (com.troydunn.rootbound.pro) is a one-time non-consumable, no subscription. It unlocks the second "You + Tree" selfie photo on a hug, the Tree insights card on each tree in the Grove, CSV / GPX export in Settings, and the map and Photos albums in Nature Roll. To see the paywall: tap the "You + Tree" photo slot when logging a hug, open a tree in the Grove and tap Tree insights, open Nature Roll, tap Map and tap the Nature map card, or open Settings (gear on Home) and tap Rootbound Pro. Restore Purchases is in Settings and on the paywall. Logging hugs with a tree photo, the map, walks from Roamr, Nature Roll's sorting, badges, leaves and the JSON export stay free.

Permissions: location while in use (pin the tree), camera and photos (tree photos; and Nature Roll, which only after the person opens it from Home or the Grove and starts a scan, reads the photo library on the device with Apple's image recognition to sort nature photos, works with Limited access and uploads nothing), HealthKit: the iPhone app only reads (heart rate, HRV, breathing rate, mindful minutes, workouts including walks and hikes); the optional Apple Watch app runs a Mind & Body workout session during a hug to measure heart rate and saves that workout to Health. Data syncs only to the user's own private iCloud (CloudKit private database). Roamr shares a summary of recent trips (times, distance, climb, speed, average heart rate and start / end rounded to about 100 m) with Rootbound on the device through a shared App Group, and Still Pointz shares recent breath sessions the same way (Rootbound shares hug dates, lengths, tree names and species, never locations); nothing is uploaded.

shots.sub: A calm little game that gets you outside.
Photo, map pin, vibe tags and how you felt.
Badges for sunrises, streaks and long sits.
Hearts, breaths and walks for every tree.
From the Oak Leaf to the Golden Elder Leaf.
